findings.evidence: POST /api/admin/menu/availability/toggle returns HTTP 500 in round 2 (NOT 200). Sidecar reports/test-e2e/rush-hour-50x50-2026-05-10/round-1/wave-E-toggle-responses.json (overwritten by round-2 run, REPORTS_DIR not bumped per spec) records 4 entries: item toggle ts=1778461554775 status=500, extra toggle ts=1778461556083 status=200, item restore ts=1778461639820 status=500, extra restore ts=1778461641021 status=200. Both invocations of /api/admin/menu/availability/toggle (state04 toggle + state18 restore) crash. Cluster-6 fix (commit 762bf7812) wrapped DispatchDomainEventsJob::dispatch in try/catch in 3 listeners (PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox, PersistItemExtraAvailabilityChangedToOutbox, PersistItemVariationAvailabilityChangedToOutbox) but MISSED a fourth listener subscribed to ItemAvailabilityChanged event: PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox.php line 97 still does unguarded DispatchDomainEventsJob::dispatch($domainEventId). Stack trace in storage/logs/laravel.log confirms: '#23 PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox.php(97): App\Jobs\DispatchDomainEventsJob::dispatch(1283)' followed by Pusher BroadcastException 'cURL error 7: Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1 port 6001'. EventServiceProvider.php line 175 wires PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox to ItemAvailabilityChanged. Extra toggle (200) bypasses this listener because ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged at line 182-184 only triggers PersistItemExtraAvailabilityChangedToOutbox (which IS guarded). Same root cause as round 1 — fix incomplete.
